args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

Per FIN-212, round_money should use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding)
instead of ROUND_HALF_UP. This fixes the failing nightly test
tests/test_money.py::test_half_even.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding`.

Fixes the failing nightly test:
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`
